Use a simpler agency system.

Conthrax is the selected display family; Inter handles body and interface copy. The five portfolio font files remain local. Their binaries stay out of shared ZIPs.

Keep attribution precise.

Conthrax requests weight 300; its CSS face is declared 400. The copied binary identifies SemiBold, version 3.000. The generated logo wordmark remains outlined artwork.

Source family names above record the website. The next page includes an actual Conthrax specimen as outlines, alongside bundled Inter copy.

44 px targets

Recommended interactive size. Retain visible keyboard focus, and pair colour with a label or another cue.

Computed sRGB contrast. Normal text requires 4.5:1; large text and essential non-text boundaries require 3:1. Logos are exempt from text contrast rules. Decorative lines must not carry essential information.

NEXUSPOINT / SOFT FOLD11 / HANDOFF AND SOURCES
READY FOR YOUR NEXT APPLICATION

The assets are yours to build with.

Editable art, verified tokens, and source evidence travel together.

Production files

logos/28 native SVGs, PNG exports, nine favicon sizes, ICO, source reference.

brand-tokens.css / .jsonImplementation colours, type roles, spacing, radius and motion tokens.

templates/ + applications/Proposal, email signature, Conthrax banners, avatar and two-sided card.

fonts/Bundled Inter desktop and web files, copyright and licence notices.

sources/ + scripts/Saved live evidence, checksums and reproducible asset builders.

Font handoff

Inter: bundled under SIL OFL 1.1. Keep the notices with shared font files.

Ethnocentric, Conthrax, Nasalization: confirm rights for each intended use through Typodermic.

Mokoto: confirm the relevant commercial rights through Drizy.

Gambetta: each contractor obtains their own copy from Fontshare. The ITF FFL 2.0 prohibits passing its font binaries to third parties.
